title: Intern Lawyer
desc:
Hyundai Motor Türkiye invites you to become part of one of the world’s leading car manufacturers. Being a member of our international team, you have the chance to form the future of mobility together with experts inside a global company with a unique success story. As a well-organized, flexible and motivated professional, you will master diverse challenges and work in a dynamic environment with a strong customer focus.
We love to defy conventions and drive ambitious future plans with responsibility when it comes to mobility, quality and design. For these aims we need the right team and therefore, we need you. At Hyundai, we believe that the success of our organization lies in the passion and diversity of individual members. That is why we also commit to supporting them in their personal development, while offering an inspiring work atmosphere.
Join us for creating future mobility.
We are looking for an
Intern Lawyer
to take part in Hyundai Motor Türkiye
in Istanbul Office
.
We Want You To:
Preparing reports and conducting legal search
Working with legal counsels, lawyers that are related with legal matters
Assist legal department team members and gain valuable cooperate law experience
You Will Also Need To Have:
Have successfully passed the Bar Exam or be awaiting the results following completion of the exam
Bachelor's degree in Law
Excellent command of both written & spoken English
Experience in working with GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) processes
Excellent command of MS Office programs
Using the SAP software
Sufficient legal knowledge
Good level of UYAP knowledge
Strong communication, facilitation, presentation, reporting and organizational skills
Result and customer oriented
We Offer
Working on a global level and recognized internationally,
Chance to enhance your competencies and unlock your potential,
Casual dress code
“Hyundai Motor Türkiye is an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity in the workplace.”
